item.title: Redemption
item.description: Project Overview Project Goal: Transform a self-written post-apocalyptic script titled “Redemption” into a highly interactive multiplayer board game that preserves the script’s tense atmosphere and internal conflicts. By integrating card mechanics, map design, hidden roles, and cooperative gameplay, the project enhances players’ immersion and emotional engagement. My Role: Game Designer & Video Editor Collaborators: Jiawei Shi – Document Organizer Jianting Liang – Card Designer & Video Editor Katrina Lai – Character & Map Designer Built With:

item.title: Beyond the Horizon
item.description: Project Overview Project Goal: To create a deeply immersive VR experience that explores themes of loss, healing, and connection. Through a combination of realistic 3D environments, atmospheric storytelling, and interactive mechanics, the project aims to evoke emotions and engage players in a personal journey of transformation. My Role: 3D Modeler & Unity Collaborators: Jayson Van Tram – Lead Programmer & Developer Man Ying Angela Lee – Visual Designer & Unity Built With:
